title: Settings
failed: The change was not saved. Please try again.
cardLine: Printed on documents; personal fields stay on this phone.
cardFromSchools: Subjects and schools come from the schools’ settings.
schoolsLine: Each school keeps its subjects, classes and bell times.
schoolGuard: Levels and subjects linked to saved classes cannot be removed here.
weekLine: One merged week for the schools, with clashes flagged.
timesLine: Match each slot to the school’s bell.
plansLine: Each class’s pack, release and status, grouped by school.
missingPack: Release {{release}} is not installed on this phone. The class stays pinned to it.
noClasses: No classes have been added to this school yet.
minutesLine: Usual planning minutes appear beside sessions, without changing buffers or the class’s position. The texts book keeps the actual duration.
languageIntro: The interface language on this phone
languageDocuments: Documents stay in the subject’s language, whatever language the interface uses. All three languages use Western digits.
languageDirection: Preview the chosen language; the interface direction changes after saving if needed.
lengthsIntro: Session lengths and their sources, by level. They are not edited here; adjust slots to match your school’s bell times.
byPeriod: Depends on the period: 30 to 90 minutes in primary
noTemplate: The installed data has no bell template for this level. Set the slots to match your school.
noRamadan: Ramadan times are not announced for this level yet, so its sessions keep their usual length until an update brings them.
lengthsRule: A shortened session still counts as one. Buffers and lesson order do not change; the texts book prints its actual times.
pinned: Each class stays on its release until you choose to change it. Recorded sessions do not change.

notify.noNames: No notification shows a name or a mark.

signature.intro: Drawn once on the screen, then placed in the teacher’s signature boxes when printing.
signature.padHint: Draw with your finger; each line is kept when you lift it. With TalkBack, double-tap and hold, then drag.
signature.tooLong: The signature is longer than can be kept. Clear it and draw it with fewer lines.
signature.use: Use the signature on printouts and PDFs
signature.drawFirst: Draw the signature first to turn it on.
signature.phoneOnly: It stays on this phone only: it is not synced or backed up.
signature.shapeOnly: Only its shape is kept, not the speed, pressure or timing of the strokes.
signature.where: It goes in the teacher’s boxes for confirmed sessions only, never in the director’s or inspector’s boxes, and never in DOCX files.
signature.legal: It is not a legal signature, and counts where the school accepts it.

logLine: Each correction, print, export and deletion
exportLine: The Minhajna archive or CSV files, free, at any time
eraseLine: Everything is erased from this phone, with no way back

retention.intro: Each kind of record has a default period, which you can change. Nothing is erased without asking you, and erasing is real: the content goes, and the activity log keeps only the fact and its day.
retention.lessonsLine: The texts book and daily journal, lesson notes and distributions, and where each class is in the plan
retention.lessonsThreeLine: Erasing is offered in July, 3 years after their school year
retention.lessonsCompare: For comparison: schools keep the texts book in their archive for at least 3 years after the school year (order 155 of 1991, article 13).
retention.lessonsShort: Lesson records until I delete them
retention.lessonsShortThree: Lesson records offered for erasing after 3 years
retention.pupilsLine: Lists, roll calls, marks, appreciations, assessment reasons and seating plans
retention.pupilsNextLine: Erasing is offered after the end of the next school year; lesson records stay
retention.pupilsOwnLine: Erasing is offered after the end of their school year; lesson records stay
retention.pupilsShortNext: Pupil data offered for erasing after the next year
retention.pupilsShortOwn: Pupil data offered for erasing after its year
retention.lessonsOn: Lesson records of {{year}}: erasing offered in {{month}}
retention.notesLine: On your devices only; they go into no statement, handover or total
retention.notesPupilsLine: Erasing is offered with their year’s pupil data
retention.logLine: Each correction, print, export and deletion, by day, without times
retention.logNote: It has no setting of its own: it follows what it describes, so it stays proof that nothing changed outside the app.
retention.logDefault: Default: kept as long as the records it describes
retention.howNotice: How erasing is offered: with exporting all your data, which shows what is erased and what stays, and offers the export first. This setting erases nothing.
retention.schoolNotice: In the school’s space, in the national system: the school’s copy and the official register follow the period the ministry announces, such as 3 years for signed weeks, like the texts book. My copy keeps these settings.

exportAll.archiveLine: Everything: the records, their history and the pinned releases. An open, documented format that every later version reads.
exportAll.csvLine: Marks, roll call and the lesson log, for spreadsheets.
exportAll.leftOut: The archive holds everything except the personal fields of the teacher card and the drawn signature: they are typed and drawn again after it is opened on another device.
exportAll.years: Every year so far: {{years}}. Choosing a single year comes with the yearly archive.
exportAll.notesLine: They go into the file only if you include them here.
exportAll.protect: Protect the file with a password
exportAll.protectLine: Recommended: the file holds pupil data.
exportAll.passwordLine: It is not kept in the file, and the project cannot recover it.
exportAll.confidential: Internal · confidential. Keep the file on a computer, an SD card or a USB key, not in a messaging app.
exportAll.saveNote: The phone’s file picker opens, and the export is written in the activity log.

eraseDevice.oneStep: One step, with no way back
eraseDevice.gone: What is erased from this phone
eraseDevice.goneBooks: The texts book, the daily journal and the lesson plans
eraseDevice.goneNotes: Private notes and the drawn signature
eraseDevice.goneKey: This phone’s key: nothing reaches it after the erasure
eraseDevice.keptNone: Nothing yet: no other device and no backup, so everything is on this phone alone.
eraseDevice.lost_one: {{count}} change has reached neither another device nor a backup, and is lost with the erasure.
eraseDevice.lost_other: {{count}} changes have reached neither another device nor a backup, and are lost with the erasure.
eraseDevice.exportLine: A file to keep on a computer, a memory card or a USB key
eraseDevice.understood: I understand that erasing cannot be undone, and that the project cannot recover anything.
eraseDevice.failed: The erasure did not finish. Try again.

devices.why: It opens once the encryption design is published and reviewed, the declaration is filed with the national data protection authority, and the server is ready in Algeria. It stays free for teachers.
devices.meanwhile: Until then, two ways with no server and no account:
devices.backupLine: An encrypted file, kept on a computer, an SD card or a USB key. No pupil data goes into the phone’s cloud backups.
devices.failed: The backup was not saved. Try again.
devices.sheetLine: Made on {{day}} · opens the backups on a new device
devices.noKey: The project holds no key, so it cannot recover the data.

recovery.title: Recovery sheet
recovery.given: Given when backups are set up
recovery.intro: This is the recovery key. It brings the data back on a new device if the phone is lost, and it opens the backups.
recovery.printOrWrite: Print the sheet, or copy the key clearly onto paper.
recovery.keep: Keep it at home, away from the phone, as you keep official papers. Do not photograph it or send it.
recovery.restores: It restores everything on a new device: the classes, the books, the roll calls, the marks and the private notes.
recovery.except: Except the personal fields of the teacher card and the drawn signature: they are typed and drawn again.
recovery.noCopy: The project has no copy of it and cannot recover it. Without this sheet, the backups do not open.
recovery.computer: On a computer, {{app}} opens the backup with this key, typed in capitals with no spaces.
recovery.guarded: Screenshots are blocked here. The key is sent to no server.
recovery.field: The recovery key, as on the sheet
recovery.placeholder: XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX
recovery.mismatch: What was typed does not match the key. Check the sheet and type it again.
recovery.newLine: If the sheet is lost, a new key replaces it. Backups made before stay on the old key, so save a new backup after it.
recovery.failed: The sheet was not saved. Try again.
